metadata.title: $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebras of small surfaces
metadata.abstract: We study the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebras of small surfaces, focusing on the closed torus and the once-punctured torus. We provide explicit finite presentations by generators and relations for the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebra of the torus and once-punctured torus, analogous to those of Bullock and Przytycki for the Kauffman bracket skein algebras. We give explicit bases of the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebras of the torus and once-punctured torus and describe the multiplicative structure of the basis for the torus, analogous to the product-to-sum formula of Frohman and Gelca. We twist the basis for the torus to obtain one with structure constants in $\mathbb{N}[q,q^{-1}].$ We compute the kernels of natural maps between the $\rm{PGL}_2$ and Kauffman bracket skein algebras associated to the once-punctured torus and closed torus. We compute the center of the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebra of the torus, which depends on the specialization of the quantum parameter $q.$

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 小曲面 PGL₂ skein 代数
analysis.workSummary: 给出闭环面及一次穿孔环面的有限表示与显式基，建立环面的 product-to-sum 型乘法、正结构常数基，计算自然映射的核以及随 q 特化变化的中心。
analysis.breakthrough: 使 PGL₂ 版本的小曲面 skein 结构可显式计算。
analysis.limitations: 中心随量子参数特化变化；不能把环面公式直接应用于任意曲面。
